goal.text: Leave the classroom the safe way.

intro.text: The shaking stopped. Your teacher is at the door.

hint.text: Follow your teacher, one step at a time.

lesson.text: When the shaking stops, walk out with your teacher. Aftershocks may come, so stay ready.

choices.label: Stay under the desk
choices.heading: Time to go
choices.feedback: The shaking stopped. Now leave the classroom with your teacher.

choices.label: Walk out with your teacher
choices.feedback: Walk out with your class. Follow your teacher to the evacuation area.

choices.label: Run and push to the door
choices.feedback: Walk. Do not run. Do not push.
